description: This Java class named UpdateProductMixCommandHandler is a handler for processing update commands related to product mixes in a loan portfolio context within the Apache Fineract framework. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a service and a command type for updating product mixes, and delegates the update operation to the ProductMixWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateProductMixCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for product mixes. Implements command processing and delegates the update operation to the write platform service.

methods.name: UpdateProductMixCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ProductMixWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by calling the write platform service's update method.
